🎉 LATEST UPDATES
- Bigger plots: up to 340 studs wide and 1200 long
- Search the Parts menu, now in 17 languages
- Lighting, Music and Gravity blocks can last a set time

🎮 Welcome to Obby Builder!

Build your own obby, customize it with fun parts and traps, then challenge friends or the whole server to beat it. Earn cash while you play, unlock bigger builds, save multiple obbies, and keep improving your creations!

📱💻🎮 Build and play on PC, Mobile, Tablet, and Console.
🏆 Get likes, climb leaderboards, and discover Trending and Highlighted obbies.
🔗 Every obby gets a slot code: share yours or paste a friend's to load it instantly.
🤝 Build together with friends using co-op mode.
🎵 Add music, buttons, signs, teleporters, checkpoints, and more.
💾 Need a backup? Use Restore Data in the Slots UI.

👍 Like + ⭐ Favorite for updates!
🔔 Follow for update drops!
👥 Join the group for bonus rewards!
